methods.sources: Alfreð (alfred.is), Starfatorg (island.is/starfatorg), Tvinna (tvinna.is), Hagvangur and Intellecta (recruiters). Collected daily since 17 October 2026; Tvinna archive back to 2010.
methods.occupations: ISCO-08 unit groups, assigned per posting by Claude (Anthropic) from the official ILO list and checked against it.
methods.exposure: ILO 2025 Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure to Generative AI: Gmyrek, P., Berg, J., Kamiński, K., et al. (2025), ILO Working Paper 140, data licensed CC BY 4.0. Scores measure technical potential, not expected job loss.
methods.caveats: Counts are unique jobs: a job advertised on several sites is counted once, matched by link, application page, or employer and title. Contact details are removed from all stored postings.
